title: Install Pudicus inspection gate: hook, receipts, PR gate

comments.author: home
comments.text: Chore opened to install Pudicus (AnthusAI/Pudicus v0.1.2, commit 3acc2a7) into BotSpy. Scope: reproducible commit-msg hook install, HMAC receipt trailers on every commit, GitHub Actions PR gate with required status check. Gate will verify only commits new in a PR; merge commits and release-plz/github-actions bot commits are exempted per design. Sequenced after the pending history anonymization force-push; branch rebased onto new develop before enabling the required check.
